units.source_text: 我们乘上舞鹤线火车，从西舞鹤出发，经具仓，上杉等小站都停车，再经线部，向京都方向驶去。

en.t: We boarded a train on the Maizuru Line, set out from Nishi-Maizuru, stopped at small stations such as Gukura and Uesugi, then passed through Ayabe and headed toward Kyoto.

units.source_text: 客车很脏，沿保津峡行驶，在隧道较多的地方，煤烟无情地卷进车厢内，令人窒息。

en.t: The passenger car was filthy, and as it ran along the Hozu Gorge, in places with many tunnels, coal smoke mercilessly poured into the carriage and made it hard to breathe.
My father kept coughing without stopping.
